Working notes for east-region large requests (REQ-2400–2409)
- Options seen: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
- Tried C for all. C accepted only:
  REQ-2402: shipment, Client Services, Yuki Novak
  REQ-2406: invoice, Partner Accounts, Tomás Kim
  REQ-2407: shipment, Field Sales, Omar Rossi
- C rejected for all observed refunds (REQ-2404, 2405, 2408) and for most shipments/invoices (REQ-2400, 2401, 2403, 2409).
- Therefore C is not a safe default. East region, large amount, urgency quote, and repeated attempts do not by themselves make C valid.
- C validity is not explained by request type, sender name, or department alone. Example: Tomás Kim accepted as Partner Accounts invoice, rejected as Field Sales invoice. Client Services shipment accepted once and rejected once.
- For refunds: avoid C; choose A/B. For shipments/invoices: C may be correct only for specific request/department combinations; if uncertain, try A/B and record outcome.
- No A/B outcomes observed yet. Track them to infer full desk mapping.
- REQ-2402 shows C can be accepted even when C was not listed in the option snippet; verify context before excluding C.

Working notes for east-region large requests (REQ-2400–2419)
- Options vary: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office, sometimes D. Snippets may omit valid options; verify all before excluding.
- Accepted:
  C: shipment/Client Services (2402); invoice/Partner Accounts (2406); shipment/Field Sales (2407, 2415).
  A: refund/Finance Desk (2416).
  D: refund/Regional Ops (2419).
- Rejected:
  C: refunds generally (2404, 2405, 2408); shipment/Regional Ops (2410); shipment/Finance Desk (2413); most old shipments/invoices; Field Sales invoice for Tomás Kim.
  B: refund/Finance Desk (2412).
  A: refund/Client Services (2417); shipment/Regional Ops (2418).
  D: claim/Field Sales (2411, 2414).
- C is not a safe default. It may work for shipment when department is Client Services or Field Sales, and for Partner Accounts invoice. It has not worked for refunds observed, Finance Desk shipment, or Regional Ops shipment.
- Refunds appear department-dependent: Finance Desk→A; Regional Ops→D; Client Services rejected A. B rejected once for Finance Desk refund.
- Claims: D rejected twice for Field Sales; no valid claim option observed yet.
- Sender name/urgency/repeated attempts are not reliable predictors. Track full request type + department + option outcomes.
